geography: Worldwide total SKYTROFA revenue (U.S. only until the Germany launch in Q3 2023)
moa: Long-acting prodrug of somatropin (growth hormone receptor agonist)

launch_evidence.quote: In fall-2021, the Company commercially launched in the U.S., TransCon hGH under the brand name of SKYTROFA (lonapegsomatropin-tcgd)

search_log: Listed every filing for CIK 1612042 (Ascendis Pharma A/S) via data.sec.gov/submissions; every 6-K from 2021-08-01 to 2026-10-26 searched (all documents per filing except XBRL viewer pages) for 'skytrofa|yorvipath'; 20-F for 2021 read for the launch-quarter figure.

Each quarter read from the quarter's own results release: the SKYTROFA revenue sentence (EUR millions) through 2024Q3 and the revenue-from-commercial-products table (EUR'000) from 2024Q4; 2023Q2 from the release's SKYTROFA revenue table (35.9; sentence rounds to €36 million); 2021Q4 derived from the 2021 20-F (943 thousand, no sales in the first nine months).

Values in EUR, the currency the releases report; one series covers total SKYTROFA revenue, which was U.S.-only until the Q3 2023 Germany launch ('SKYTROFA was launched in U.S. in Q4 2021, Germany in Q3 2023', January 2024 presentation).
